rules: Only current original HTML observations are price evidence; search caches and prior prices are discovery only.
Domestic NEW retail BOX/WOF only; bulk, multipack, overseas, refurb, anniversary and other CPUs are excluded.
Regular data-base-price in active Danawa merchant purchase rows only; shipping, membership, coupon, cash and promotional prices excluded.
Manufacturer Product ID Boxed or exact Intel boxed Ordering Code must match sale package. Existing source identity, partNumber, canonicalID, model role and DB are preserved.
No price on reviewed page is page-scoped; it does not prove global unavailability.
Manufacturer model-reference items remain held for separate exact retail SKU approval.

Outlier boxed quotes are eligible only where an independent seller original product page confirms exact advertised CPU/package, ordinary KRW amount and current in-stock/purchase evidence. They retain an outlier flag for explicit review; expensive alone is not proof of wrong price.
